headline: Source: Commanders DT Daron Payne suffered season-ending foot injury
summary: Commanders defensive tackle Daron Payne suffered a season-ending Jones fracture in practice Friday, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

headline: NFL to review additional allegations against Packers RB Josh Jacobs
summary: The NFL said it will look into additional allegations of physical and verbal abuse by Packers RB Josh Jacobs that were revealed as part of a public records release from the Hobart/Lawrence Police Department.

headline: Jonathan Taylor trade talks are "active and ongoing"
summary: Seahawks, Packers, Broncos, Vikings, Giants are pegged as potential destinations.

headline: Where the 2026 Vikings rank among worst 6-0 NFL teams ever
summary: Aaron Schatz ranked the worst 6-0 teams ever by DVOA and point differential. Where do the 2026 Vikings land, and what's next for them?

headline: Panthers Fire Defensive Coordinator Ejiro Evero; Todd Wash Named Interim DC
summary: On the heels of a 27-19 loss to the Packers on Thursday night, the Panthers are making major changes to their coaching staff. headline: Ravens have become the ultimate good half/bad half team
summary: The Baltimore Ravens have fallen from 4-1 to 4-3, thanks to a pair of division games in which a 10-0 halftime lead against the Browns became a loss and a 13-0 halftime lead against the Bengals became a loss.
